label: the worker contract drops the source-text rule: a text-only test passes as evidence again
old: - An assertion on a production file's text (grep/cat over rsi/runtime/*.sh, a .py or a scripts/*.sh) is not behaviour evidence: the named test must execute the production path (bash, source, python3, the real function), or a mutant must turn the behaviour into a no-op and redden it. A test that stays green when the code becomes a no-op is a rework round, not a claim.
